We’re looking for a hands-on, structured and ownership-driven engineer who is comfortable working on the shop floor, diagnosing complex issues, challenging suppliers constructively and improving equipment performance over time.</p> <p>This is a site-based role in an operational warehouse environment, with regular presence on the shop floor. As the sorter design is already finalised, the initial focus will be to take ownership of the installed system and optimise it after go-live.</li> <li>Work side by side with the OEM / integrator engineers: collect technical knowledge, challenge design choices, maintainability, access, spare-part strategy and the proposed maintenance plan before final approval.</li> <li>Define and verify the Maintenance acceptance criteria (documentation, training, spare-parts, safety, availability targets).
